entries.Character_CoopHelpString: Starting Cabins: Start with 1-{0} cabins already in place, allowing your friends to join immediately. Alternatively, you can select "None" and build the cabins yourself (via Robin).^^Cabin Layout: If you decide to start your farm with pre-existing cabins, you can choose between two layout styles: "Nearby" places all cabins near the main farmhouse, encouraging a communal farming style. "Separate" places the cabins far apart, allowing more room for independence.^^Profit Margin: Adjusts the profit margin (money you earn) on goods you sell. 'Normal' is the original Stardew Valley experience. More experienced and/or larger groups may wish to decrease the margin.
entries.Character_CoopHelpString2: Money Style: You can choose how money is earned and spent. In "Shared" mode, all players share the same pool of money. In "Separate" mode, each player has their own, individual pool of money. "Shared" is the classic Stardew Valley experience.
entries.Character_FarmBeach: Beach Farm_Good foraging and fishing, and tons of open space. Sometimes, supply crates wash up on shore. However, sprinklers don't work in the sandy soil.
entries.Character_FarmCombat: Wilderness Farm_There's plenty of good land here, but beware... at night the monsters come out.
entries.Character_FarmFishing: Riverland Farm_Your farm is spread across several islands and scenic riverbanks. Fish are more common here than usual. You start with a fish smoker.
entries.Character_FarmForaging: Forest Farm_The woods limit your farming space. However, the bounty of the forest is nearly at your doorstep...
entries.Character_FarmFourCorners: Four Corners Farm_The land is divided into four parcels, each with its own perk. Perfect for a group!
entries.Character_FarmMining: Hill-top Farm_Rocky terrain and a winding river make it difficult to design your farm. However, a mineral deposit provides mining opportunities.
entries.Character_FarmStandard: Standard Farm_A simple plot of land, with a large amount of open space to design your farm.

entries.android_storage_migration:
Stardew Valley needs to perform a one time copy of your farms to a new location for the 1.5 update of the game.

In the following screen please select the `StardewValley` folder and tap 'Use this folder'.

entries.tutorial1: First, choose your appearance and farm type. When you're done, tap the check mark button to start playing.
entries.tutorial10: Try preparing a garden patch to sow your first seeds.
entries.tutorial11: Great work... time to add some seeds.
entries.tutorial12: They look thirsty - there's a watering can in the toolbar.
entries.tutorial13: Well done! Remember to water your crops every day.
entries.tutorial14: Once you've finished watering, feel free to explore Pelican Town and meet your new neighbors!
entries.tutorial15: You can fill your watering can at a pond or river.
entries.tutorial16: Tap and hold to walk toward your finger.
entries.tutorial17: Hold and drag to follow your finger around.
entries.tutorial18: Let's take a look at some other game functions.
entries.tutorial19: The Inventory shows the items you're holding. You can drag them to rearrange, or to the trash to destroy them.
entries.tutorial2: Good morning! Remember to head back to the farmhouse to sleep and save your game later on.
entries.tutorial20: This page shows your skills - you can improve your skills by using tools, foraging, fishing and fighting.
entries.tutorial21: The Social page tells you about your relationships with the people you meet.
entries.tutorial22: This is where you can craft new items from the things you collect and grow. You will discover new crafting recipes throughout the game.
entries.tutorial23: Slide your finger over the map to explore Pelican Town and its surroundings.
entries.tutorial24: The Collections page keeps track of what you've shipped, fished, mined, cooked or discovered.
entries.tutorial25: In stores, tap on the counter in front of the shopkeeper to buy or sell goods.
entries.tutorial26: We need some seeds to plant... did you miss something back in the farmhouse?
entries.tutorial3: You've received a gift! Tap on the package to open it.
entries.tutorial4: New quests are shown in the Journal. Tap on a quest to take a closer look - there's useful information there!
entries.tutorial5: Tap the Close button when you're done with the Journal.
entries.tutorial6: Looks like quite a mess! Let's clear this place up.
entries.tutorial7: Tap on a weed to clear it.
entries.tutorial8: Well done! Try clearing some more weeds and rocks.
entries.tutorial9: You can use the hoe to prepare the soil for planting.
entries.tutorial_auto_attack: You can choose between auto and manual attack modes on the game options screen.
